ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupying the distal 70% of each lobe; a central, irregular black pigment region concentrated around the median notch; high-density black punctate mottling along the leading edges and sparsely within the white lateral fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth reaching roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude serration map; irregular jagged peaks and valleys ranging from 4 to 12 pixels in depth along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in irregular, weathered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of roughly circular, white-on-black ring-like structures (barnacle attachment scars) localized primarily in the dark medial region surrounding the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the white ventral field of the right lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant erosive damage and jagged tissue loss on the distal tips of both lobes; extensive circular scarring patterns across the central black pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly fragmented trailing edge boundary with unique, non-uniform serration patterns that break the linear contour.
